about: Slot plaintexts after the commitment block (docs/VAULT.md §7) written by hand from §7's layout, each with what a reader makes of it: "ok", or the faraday_vault::records::Fault that refuses it. Each is read whole: the format byte, the seal count (type 16, count 1) where the case has one, the records, the end record and eight zero bytes.

cases.case: a GPG key with its primary creation time (type 7, fields 1 and 2)
a GPG key without its primary creation time: type 7's field 2 is required
a signing round with fields 1 to 4 (type 9)
a signing round without field 2: type 9's fields 2 to 4 are required
a signing round without field 3: type 9's fields 2 to 4 are required
a signing round without field 4: type 9's fields 2 to 4 are required
a recovery sheet payload of exactly 16 KiB (type 5)
a recovery sheet payload of 16 KiB and one byte: §7 caps the payload at 16 KiB
two passphrase records for two keys (type 14)
two passphrase records for one key: at most one per key and slot
two signed amounts records for two transactions (type 10)
two signed amounts records for one transaction: one record per transaction
a slot with no seal count: every slot holds exactly one (type 16)
a slot with two seal counts
a seal count with the time of the last seal (type 16, fields 1 and 2)
a seal count of 0: the count is 1 or more
